"""URL slugs."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents folded to their base letters, words joined by single hyphens."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title.lower())
    s = "".join(ch for ch in s if not unicodedata.combining(ch))
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")
EOF
cat > textutil/truncate.py <<'EOF'
"""Text truncation for previews."""


def truncate(text, limit):
    """Shorten text to at most `limit` characters, cutting at a word boundary and adding "..."."""
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    budget = limit - 3
    head = text[:budget]
    if text[budget].isspace():
        # the cut falls exactly between words
        cut = head.rstrip()
    else:
        # the cut would split a word: back up to the last complete word
        idx = head.rfind(" ")
        cut = head[:idx].rstrip() if idx > 0 else ""
    if not cut:
        # no complete word fits; fall back to a hard cut
        cut = head
    return cut + "..."
EOF

def truncate(text, limit):
    """Shorten text to at most `limit` characters, cutting at a word boundary and adding "..."."""
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    budget = limit - 3
    head = text[:budget]
    if text[budget].isspace():
        # the cut falls exactly between words
        cut = head.rstrip()
    else:
        # the cut would split a word: back up to the last complete word
        idx = head.rfind(" ")
        cut = head[:idx].rstrip() if idx > 0 else ""
    if not cut:
        # no complete word fits; fall back to a hard cut
        cut = head
    return cut + "..."
